items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Oh, I had George Lewis. At various times they would play together a while and Georgey Boy, certainly I, Neely Bones, at certain times they would have two jobs and split up.

ctx.x: He was really great blues man. Who did Chris have in his band, if you'd say so?

Oh, I had George Lewis. At various times they would play together a while and Georgey Boy, certainly I, Neely Bones, at certain times they would have two jobs and split up. I saw him have jobs in using two clarinet players in the band. Do you remember who the two were? Yeah. We had Zeb, Neely, times like that, you know. Georgey Boy and George Lewis. Mostly it would be Tyne, like maybe perhaps he was short of a man, a trombone player, or either a bass player. It must have sounded good. It must have sounded good.…
Albert's system, Albert's system, Albert's system, no Barum system.
